label: boot
eval: ({spec: __plexora.viewState.spec(), depth: __plexora.viewState.depth, prefs: window.PlexoraViewerPrefs.get(), smooth: PlexoraViewerPrefs.smoothMotion(), ghost: !!__plexora.planeMotion.fade.ghost, items: __plexora.seaDragonViewer.viewer.world.getItemCount()})

label: one step: fade trace
eval: (async () => { const vs = __plexora.viewState; const fade = __plexora.planeMotion.fade; const log = []; const cap = fade.capture.bind(fade), rel = fade.release.bind(fade); const t0 = performance.now(); fade.capture = () => { const r = cap(); log.push({t: Math.round(performance.now()-t0), what: 'capture', r}); return r; }; fade.release = () => { rel(); log.push({t: Math.round(performance.now()-t0), what: 'release', ms: fade.duration()}); }; vs.step(1); const samples = []; await new Promise(res => { const f = () => { const g = fade.ghost; samples.push([Math.round(performance.now()-t0), g ? (g.hidden ? 'hidden' : Number(getComputedStyle(g).opacity).toFixed(2)) : 'none']); if (performance.now()-t0 < 2500) requestAnimationFrame(f); else res(); }; requestAnimationFrame(f); }); await vs.settled(); fade.capture = cap; fade.release = rel; return {log, samples: samples.filter((s,i,a)=> i===0 || s[1] !== a[i-1][1]).slice(0,30), applied: vs.appliedSpec()}; })()

label: prefetch warmed z+1 (resource timing)
eval: (async () => { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const z = __plexora.viewState.get().z; const want = 'view=z' + (z+1); const hits = performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(e => e.name.includes(want)); return {z, warmed: hits.length}; })()

label: step into warmed plane: time to commit
eval: (async () => { const vs = __plexora.viewState; const fade = __plexora.planeMotion.fade; const cap = fade.capture.bind(fade); let at = null; const t0 = performance.now(); fade.capture = () => { at = Math.round(performance.now()-t0); return cap(); }; vs.step(1); await vs.settled(); fade.capture = cap; return {commitAfterMs: at, settledMs: Math.round(performance.now()-t0)}; })()

label: scrub 12 steps 40ms apart
eval: (async () => { const vs = __plexora.viewState; const fade = __plexora.planeMotion.fade; const log = []; const cap = fade.capture.bind(fade), rel = fade.release.bind(fade); const t0 = performance.now(); fade.capture = () => { const r = cap(); log.push(['c', Math.round(performance.now()-t0)]); return r; }; fade.release = () => { rel(); log.push(['r', fade.duration()]); }; const start = vs.get().z; for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { vs.step(1); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 40)); } await vs.settled(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); fade.capture = cap; fade.release = rel; return {from: start, to: vs.get().z, applied: vs.appliedSpec(), swaps: log.filter(e=>e[0]==='c').length, log, ghostHiddenAtRest: fade.ghost.hidden}; })()

label: mid-fade screenshot setup
eval: (async () => { const vs = __plexora.viewState; vs.set({z: vs.get().z + 15}); await vs.settled(); return vs.get().z; })()

label: thumb: rail geometry
eval: (() => { const r = __plexora.depthStrip.track.getBoundingClientRect(); window.__rail = r; return {top: r.top, height: r.height, x: r.left + r.width/2}; })()

mouseFrom: (() => { const r = window.__rail; const top = __plexora.viewState.depth - 1; const y = (z) => r.top + r.height * z / top; const x = r.left + r.width/2; return [['press', x, y(40.0), 30], ['move', x, y(44.4), 30], ['move', x, y(47.38), 60]]; })()
label: drag rail to z 47.38
thumb mid-drag (between planes)
eval: (() => { const top = __plexora.viewState.depth - 1; const pct = parseFloat(__plexora.depthStrip.thumb.style.top); return {thumbZ: +(pct/100*top).toFixed(2), stateZ: __plexora.viewState.get().z, dragging: __plexora.depthStrip.rail.classList.contains('is-dragging')}; })()

mouseFrom: (() => { const r = window.__rail; const top = __plexora.viewState.depth - 1; const y = (z) => r.top + r.height * z / top; const x = r.left + r.width/2; return [['release', x, y(47.38), 300]]; })()
label: release
thumb after release (on the plane)
eval: (async () => { await __plexora.viewState.settled(); const top = __plexora.viewState.depth - 1; const pct = parseFloat(__plexora.depthStrip.thumb.style.top); return {thumbZ: +(pct/100*top).toFixed(3), stateZ: __plexora.viewState.get().z, transition: getComputedStyle(__plexora.depthStrip.thumb).transitionDuration}; })()
